create_tokenizer_from_pretrained: create a pretrained tokenizer from a model name or local directory path with caching support
add_special_tokens_to_vocab: add special tokens like cls, sep, pad, bos, eos to the tokenizer vocabulary and link them to class attributes
encode_text_to_token_ids: encode text or text pairs into token id sequences with optional special token injection
decode_token_ids_to_text: decode a sequence of token ids back into a human-readable string with optional special token removal
save_tokenizer_to_directory: save the tokenizer vocabulary, added tokens, and special token mappings to a local directory for reloading
